node.title: Official-row low-square-mass E1 collision-pair budget
node.statement: At each of the six pair-feasible RowC/prize envelopes, bound the total unordered same-E1 class pairs with S<=2ell by its exact row budget. The binding prize rate-1/8 budget is 65127585921474870475467050631501738502567, about 1.714K; maximum low-mass collision degree three is sufficient. The weighted-kernel dictionary gives E_low=(1/2)sum_d M_ell(a(d),b(d)). The maximum profile (3,6,S=18) is paid exactly at its four-orbit upper bound. For the next profile (2,10,S=18), cofactor 1538 is now excluded and the coarse envelope is T_210<=266; the remaining split-prime cofactors are 514 and 1028 above 257. The Plotkin compiler then forces more than B* values.
node.attack_surface: attack the profile-(2,10) cofactor-1028 branch through its universal V<=12 window, using finite-field autocorrelation types and exact real-cyclotomic norms before any support census; then treat 514, never merge distinct Q_s, and preserve orientation, stabilizer, and class-pair multiplicities in the residual weighted ledger
node.falsifier: an admissible row whose exact unordered low-mass collision-pair count exceeds its printed budget, or a multiplicity/type error in a claimed count
